chunks: 23 – Muhammad ibn Qays, Abu Nasr, al-Asadi. Trustworthy, trustworthy.

key_terms.ثِقَةٌ: Trustworthy (a technical term in hadith sciences indicating reliability)

ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn Qays al-Asadi and what is his status as a narrator in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry from the book *Kitab al-Du'afa* provides a biographical assessment of the narrator Muhammad ibn Qays, identifying him by his kunya (Abu Nasr) and tribe (al- Asadi). The repetition of the term 'thiqa' (trustworthy) emphasizes his reliability in transmitting hadith.
